text:
Type: ombré wool area rug
Use: color statement under seating; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: modern, contemporary, minimalist
Materials: wool, fine low pile
Colors: bright red, warm orange-red
Shape: rectangular, solid fade from red to coral, finely textured surface, clean edges, medium-large
Feel: bold, warm, energetic
Goes with: dark wood, grey or white furniture, neutral walls; modern rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Ombré Wool Rug, 5' x 8', Red
product.description: Pile: 100% Wool, Backing: 100% Canvas Imported Deep and light hues fade into each other in this ombré pattern rug. Subtle yet striking, this 100% wool rug is high on style and softness. Area rug features an ombré pattern Hand-tufted with 100% wool fibers Plush .65'' pile suits high-traffic indoor areas Pair with a rug pad (sold separately) 5' x 8' Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag
